# FlyerTalk

> > The world's most popular frequent flyer community covering airline loyalty programs, elite status, and travel news

FlyerTalk is the premier online community for frequent flyers, featuring news and discussions about major airline loyalty programs including Delta SkyMiles, American AAdvantage, JetBlue TrueBlue, and programs from United Airlines, Southwest Airlines, British Airways, and others. The site covers airline partnerships, status matches, credit card offers, and industry developments affecting travelers.

## Key Topics

- Loyalty programs (SkyMiles, AAdvantage, TrueBlue)
- Elite status and status matches
- Delta Air Lines
- American Airlines
- JetBlue
- Spirit Airlines
- Frontier Airlines
- United Airlines
- British Airways
- Airline partnerships and reciprocal loyalty
- Ultra-low-cost carriers
- Points and miles earning
- Credit card offers
- On-time performance rankings
- Airline mergers and acquisitions

## Airline Loyalty Programs & Elite Status

- [American Offers Limited-Time JetBlue Status Match](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/american-offers-limited-time-jetblue-status-match.html): American AAdvantage status match for JetBlue Mosaic members through June 2025
- [JetBlue Finds New Loyalty Reciprocity Partner with TAP Air Portugal](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/jetblue-finds-new-loyalty-reciprocity-partner-with-tap-air-portugal.html): JetBlue TrueBlue Mosaic partners with TAP Air Portugal for loyalty benefits
- [Delta Partners with Uber to Earn SkyMiles](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/delta-partners-with-uber-to-earn-skymiles.html): Delta SkyMiles partnership with Uber and Uber Eats for miles earning
- [British Airways Opens Double Tier Points Promotion for Holiday Travel](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/british-airways-opens-double-tier-points-promotion-for-holiday-travel.html): British Airways Executive Club double tier points for vacation packages
- [Alaska Exec Says Flyers Want Loyalty Based on Spending](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/alaska-exec-says-flyers-want-loyalty-based-on-spending.html): Alaska Airlines VP Brett Catlin defends revenue-based loyalty programs
- [Would You Join Ryanair Prime?](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/would-you-join-ryanair-prime.html): Ryanair launches Prime membership with reserved seats and travel insurance

## Airline Industry News & Mergers

- [Spirit Breaks Out of Bankruptcy Without Merger](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/spirit-breaks-out-of-bankruptcy-without-merger.html): Spirit Airlines exits Chapter 11 bankruptcy as independent carrier
- [Spirit, Frontier Remain at Odds Over Potential Merger](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/spirit-frontier-remain-at-odds-over-potential-merger.html): Spirit and Frontier Airlines continue merger negotiations amid disagreements
- [Frontier Airlines Goes First Class in 2025](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/frontier-airlines-goes-first-class-in-2025.html): Frontier Airlines introduces first class seating starting late 2025
- [Delta Cuts Summer Capacity on Signals of Uncertainty](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/delta-cuts-summer-capacity-on-signals-of-uncertainty.html): Delta Air Lines reduces summer capacity amid economic uncertainty signals
- [Making Air Travel Great Again? The Public Would Like a Word…](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/making-air-travel-great-again-the-public-would-like-a-word.html): Public feedback on air travel regulation under Transportation Secretary Duffy

- [American Signs Citi as Exclusive Credit Card Provider, Dropping Barclays](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/american-signs-citi-as-exclusive-credit-card-provider-dropping-barclays.html): American Airlines partners exclusively with Citi, drops Barclays in 2026
- [Hilton Adds New Limited Time Credit Card Offers, More Hotels to SLH](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/hilton-adds-new-limited-time-credit-card-offers-more-hotels-to-slh.html): Hilton Honors Amex card offers and Small Luxury Hotels expansion
- [Hyatt Strengthens Central America & Caribbean Position with Playa Acquisition](https://www.flyertalk.com/articles/hyatt-strengthens-central-america-caribbean-position-with-playa-acquisition.html): Hyatt acquires Playa Hotels & Resorts for $2.6B, expands all-inclusive portfolio
